type Messages interface
  ObserveDelivery(reference MessageRef, pairingEpoch string) (ObserveDeliveryResult, error)
  InboxesForPerson(cursor string) (InboxPage, error)
  InboxOpenChat(instance, sourceContext, status string, binding ChatBinding) (ChatInboxChange, error)
  SendChat(instance, sourceContext string, request ChatSendRequest) (SendResult, error)
  Prepare(instance, sourceContext string, request PrepareRequest) (PrepareResult, error)
  Reply(instance, sourceContext, messageID, body string) (SendResult, error)
  InboxOpen(instance, context, status string) (InboxChange, error)
  InboxesList(query InboxQuery) (InboxPage, error)
  Send(instance, sourceContext string, request SendRequest) (SendResult, error)
  Wait(instance, context string, view View, after, revision string, waitMs int64) (Page, error)
  ReadForPerson(messageID string) (Page, error)
  StopForPerson(messageID string) (StopResult, error)
  TurnWake(instance, sourceContext, wake string) (TurnWakeResult, error)

  FrameExchanger
